name: dsh-auto-review
description: Second-model AI auto-review on the DSH approval chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default and fully auditable from the session log.
longDescription: 审批链上的第二模型 AI 自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的结构化 allow/deny 裁决，默认失败即拒绝，全程可在会话日志中审计。
